evaluator.name: Critical Thinking Evaluator
evaluator.description: Rates grade 8-10 student argumentative essays for Critical Thinking across five indicators (synthesizing sources, evidence strength, counterarguments, facts over opinions, drawing conclusions) plus an Overall rating, on a five-level scale (not_evident to extending).

preprocessing.description: How many source passages the caller passed. Counted from the list before it is rendered as markdown, and bound into the prompt as {source_count}.

steps.description: Single-call LLM step producing per-indicator ratings (evidence + rationale before each rating) and the Overall rating last.

tolerance.notes: If allow_adjacent_levels is true, predictions within one rubric step of the expected label count as a pass. Not Evident < Exploring < Analyzing < Integrating < Extending. It is false here because a neighboring level would accept a slide from Integrating back to Extending on the single-source fabricated-citation case, which is the failure that case guards.
